purpose: Freeze the successful pilot_9_v6 WarehousePickingWave complex run, deterministic workflow interaction evaluation, effective code, tests, inputs, and reports before proceeding to the final complex sample.
workflow_evidence: Creating a wave assigns selected orders and emits the wave event.
Picking all lines allows the active wave to complete and emits the complete event.
An unresolved exception blocks completion; resolving it permits completion.
Date.now-based exception identifiers are evaluated with an explicit deterministic clock.
known_limitations: The interaction evaluator is a lightweight in-memory execution layer, not real-browser automation or screenshot comparison.
Select/option bindings, keyed-list identity, CSS state colors, and click hit targets still require real-browser verification.
The model run did not use a recorded random seed, so this single complex result is case evidence rather than a statistical success-rate estimate.
